typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Client Name} as string,
		{Reporting Date} as string,
		{Title (Title)} as string,
		Product as string,
		Contracts as string,
		Reason as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Trade_Date as string,
		Client_Name as string,
		Reporting_Date as string,
		Title__Title_ as string,
		Product as string,
		Contracts as double,
		Reason as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Trade_Date = {Trade Date},
		Client_Name = {Client Name},
		Reporting_Date = {Reporting Date},
		Title__Title_ = {Title (Title)},
		Product,
		Contracts,
		Reason),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
